source: Decision-Right Holder Register, drafts 1 to 3, Howard Diesel

roles.name: Data Governance Steering Committee
roles.definition: The highest governance authority: sets direction, mandates strategy formulation, accepts the readiness baseline and ensures the funding. Howard 22 Sep: 'the highest authority and ensures funding'.

roles.name: Data Governance Council
roles.definition: Ratifies every governance instrument, the data security policy (DS-01) included, and the ethics and metadata strategies; clears or withdraws a use and closes ethics incidents. Accountable to the Steering Committee. Howard 22 Sep: card e1 b.

roles.name: Chief Data Officer
roles.definition: The executive accountable for data as an enterprise asset: approves strategies (ethics, quality) and sponsors valuation. Howard 22 Sep: separate from the Chief Data Steward.

roles.name: Chief Data Steward
roles.definition: Top tier of the stewardship ladder: opens a strategy revision (DG-10). Operating model, vacancies and readiness went to the Data Governance Practice Manager (card G-DG b).

roles.name: Enterprise Data Steward
roles.definition: Stewardship tier across all domains: assigns domain stewardship and publishes the sharing service.

roles.name: Domain Data Steward
roles.definition: Stewardship tier for one master data domain (customer, product, party): validates the domain's definitions and speaks for the domain across business areas. Howard 22 Sep: 'a Domain Data Steward for a Master Data Domain'. Its rights are card F2.

roles.name: Coordinating Data Steward
roles.definition: Stewardship tier that coordinates the business stewards: assigns issue resolution, runs practice gaps and ethical use assessment.

roles.name: Business Data Steward
roles.definition: Stewardship tier within a business area: logs issues, brings assets into metadata scope, classifies, keeps the privacy basis, answers data subject requests, publishes reference data and confirms golden records.

roles.name: Technical Data Steward
roles.definition: Stewardship tier over the technical representation: agrees exchange specifications and access, accepts integrated metadata and declares it stale, refreshed or archived.

roles.name: Data Owner
roles.definition: Accountable for a Data Asset: its issues, its quality expectations and outcomes, and acceptance of residual security risk (DS-04, card G-DS c).

roles.name: Data Product Owner
roles.definition: Accountable for a data product as a product: release, adoption and retirement; distinct from the owner of the source data.

roles.name: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Architecture Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Document and Content Management Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Governance Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Handling Ethics Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Integration and Interoperability Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Quality Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Metadata Management Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager
roles.definition: One per Knowledge Area, thirteen in all: the manager of that KA's practice, who approves the strategy and architecture and runs the programme. Howard 22 Sep: cards e3 c and G. The Information Security Officer is the Data Security Practice Manager.

roles.name: Data Architect
roles.definition: Data architecture at every scope: enterprise blueprint, model and roadmap, integration, metadata, master data, storage, warehouse and big data platform architecture. Howard 22 Sep: one role, scope carried by the right.

roles.name: Big Data Platform Architect
roles.definition: Decides, provisions, scales and decommissions a big data platform. Howard 22 Sep: kept as the original role, apart from the Data Architect.

roles.name: Data Modeller
roles.definition: Conceptual, logical and physical data models and the model standards.

roles.name: Business Analyst
roles.definition: Business requirements for models and exchanges.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.definition: Builds and runs exchanges, warehouses and populations.

roles.name: Database Administrator
roles.definition: Environments, backup, archive, migration and purge of stored instances; separated from the Data Engineer.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.definition: Hypotheses, models, validation and deployment of analytical models.

roles.name: Data Quality Analyst
roles.definition: Declares and resolves golden record conflicts from quality evidence.

roles.name: Records and Information Manager
roles.definition: Records and content in one role: records strategy and policy, information architecture, capture, classification, publication and withdrawal of content, declaration, archive and disposition of records. Howard 22 Sep: card e5 b.

roles.name: Information Security Officer
roles.definition: The Data Security Practice Manager (card G-DS c): security instruments, security incidents and sanitisation. Residual risk is accepted by the Data Owner, not by this role.

roles.name: Legal Counsel
roles.definition: Legal holds and matters.

roles.name: Internal Audit
roles.definition: Independent review of security controls.

roles.name: Change Manager
roles.definition: Change and communication for the ethics programme.
